findings: Export uses CreateDocument(application/json), import uses OpenDocument and immediately delegates returned URIs to reviewed ViewModel routines. Picker callbacks do not add byte/item limits or transaction validation.
UI constrains screenshot JPEG quality to 95/90/85/75 and default speed to 1/1.5/2. This bounds ordinary menu input but does not establish validation of persisted values in the repository API.
Settings explicitly exposes screenshot-deletes-video, so the previously identified failed-conversion deletion branch is reachable through an ordinary user setting.
Duplicate scan scope offers ALL_FILES, INCLUDE_LIST and EXCLUDE_LIST; list management is hidden only for ALL_FILES. No active-scan restriction is passed to these controls in these ranges.

SettingsItem uses pointerInput(Unit) with optional click/long-click callbacks rather than clickable/combinedClickable semantics. Keyboard/accessibility activation and callback freshness need runtime assessment.
Setting section definitions are remembered once and contain composable lambdas using delegated state values; no stale-state defect is inferred without checking actual Kotlin/Compose capture behavior.
